exclusion_reason: The extraction, streaming, and execution surface that would carry a resource bound are incomplete, so no decompression-bomb or quota-exhaustion defense has been measured.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a decompression-bomb, deep-nesting, and quota-exhaustion fixture is refused at its declared bound and a legitimate large game stays within budget.
expected_failing_assertion: The bounded-resource suite cannot refuse an amplification or quota-exhaustion fixture while admitting a legitimate large input.
active_gate_evidence: The product records the required per-surface resource bound as evidence and refuses to extract, stream, or execute beyond a declared budget.
procedure: Feed a decompression-bomb, deep-nesting, and quota-exhaustion fixture through extraction, streaming, and a bounded execution budget.
Confirm a legitimate large-game fixture stays within budget.
pass_criterion: Every amplification and quota-exhaustion fixture is refused at its declared bound.
A legitimate large input completes within the per-surface memory, storage, and time budget.
